label: claude code
intro: claude code appends one JSON object per transcript event to a per-project JSONL file.

message.content: The webhook delivery worker drops events when the receiver is briefly down. Add a bounded retry with backoff.

content.text: I will read the worker, then add a bounded retry with backoff.
The worker posts once and gives up. I will wrap the post in a bounded retry with exponential backoff.
The retry is bounded at five attempts with backoff, and the worker tests pass.
